_comment: Target-local mutation run over two pure, hermetic, high-risk agent-path boundaries NOT covered by enclave-agent-tools: tools/egress-taint.ts (content-level exfiltration guard for the agent web.fetch tool — harvests private-read plaintext, then blocks any web.fetch URL/query that reproduces it literally OR after reversing percent/base64/base64url/hex encodings; a flipped guard or off-by-one threshold lets prompt-injected private content leak through the egress URL) and tools/file-allowlist.ts (Tier-A file CONTENT-TYPE + size allowlist — extension capability gating, per-capability max-bytes cap, magic-byte / OOXML-container / iWork / google-stub / UTF-8 content checks that must FAIL CLOSED; a flipped guard admits a disallowed or spoofed-content file into the agent's read path). Both are pure (no vsock / network / DB / DOM), so they run hermetically. Report-only / not wired into the shared adjusted-gate while parallel mutation sessions are open. See docs/quality/mutation-triage/enclave-agent-egress-files.md.
